results.name: Repainted Cassie Cage
results.description:
Cassie's undoubtedly one of the standout stars among the new MKX characters, and while her design was innovative and fun, I still felt there were a few ways it could be tweaked for improvement. I've repainted her outfit into a more durable and rough texture with an iridescent sheen, as well as removing her makeup and enhancing her skin texture. I've also made her bodysuit more solid and protective across the chest - better to avoid serious damage! 
Technical details:
-Face and hands repainted into the usual skin texture style. Eyeshadow, lipstick, and nail polish reduced. Hair is a more natural dark blonde. Bun removed, haircut shorter and smoothed back. 
-Bodysuit extensively revised for sturdy yet eye-catching surface textures. Diffuse repainted, new specs/norms. Yellow color changed & added to shoulder and wrists.
-Armature adjusted: muscular arms, eyelids more naturally posed, chest flattened to fit in bodysuit normally.
-Dog tags fixed to say Cassie Cage, not Jackson Briggs.

results.name: Duty Free Shop
results.description: This duty-free shop contains lipsticks, perfumes, cosmetics and watches. I used MAYA, SubstancePainter and ZBrush during the production process. The map refers to the hot items of Chanel, Gucci, Dior, Longines, Cartier, EsteeLauder, Lancome and other brands. Finally, all the objects are imported into Unity. You can go to my Artstation to see the final rendering effect. Most of the models are LOW-POLY, with a total face count of about 630,000. I think you can use my model as a reference in the process of making the same type of scene. Of course, the tedious textures are made by you. I hope you like it, thank you.

results.name: Tribes Vengeance Julia
results.description:
Victoria’s daughter Julia, the yellow-eyed protagonist of Tribes: Vengeance. Another popular character from the Tribes series.

The model was exported, textured and bone rigged by me. Credits go to Vivendi Universal, Irrational Games and Sierra Entertainment for the original and for making this game. Much love to this character. Julia is best girl.

Julia is the daughter of Queen Victoria and Phoenix Leader Daniel from the Tribes series of games. With the first iteration of her she had brown eyes but they were changed to mechanically gold eyes that were surgically implanted in her. This was to give her HUD information without the need for bulky head gear that was needed by tribesman. She wears a special armor that has a special plating that makes the armor light and it has jets mounted on to it. She is caught up in this twisted tale that includes her parents hopes, tension between tribes, and also a quite elaborate plan to destroy the Tribals. (Taken from Giantbomb.com)

Also I might just love Tara Strong.

results.name: Lipstick (requested)
results.description:
Lipstick is a cosmetic product containing pigments, oils, waxes, and emollients that apply color, texture, and protection to the lips.
Many colors and types of lipstick exist. As with most other types of makeup, lipstick is typically, but not exclusively, worn by women. Some lipsticks are also lip balms, to add color and hydration.
Although the name originally applied to the baton (stick) of material, within a tubular container, usually around 10mm in diameter and 50mm in length the term has now generally transposed to the material itself, regardless of method of application.

results.name: Roxanne
results.description: Roxanne is an animatronic wolf with a punk rock aesthetic. Her eyes are bright yellow, while her fur is gray. She wears purple lipstick and toenail paint, green fingernail paint, and face paint with a series of black markings. Her hair is long and silver, with a bright green streak. Just like Glamrock Chica, there is a panel-like seam under her chest, as well as on both of her outer upper arms, but additionally has panels in the same relative position on her upper thighs. She also has light grey markings on the inside of her ears, paw pads, around her muzzle, and on her belly. Her clothes consist of a red crop top t-shirt printed with some black star shapes that exposes her stomach, black earrings, bracelets around the wrists and neck, a spiked belt, red short-shorts, and red shoulder pauldrons.

results.name: Orange Arming Sword Lightsaber
results.description:
My [KotOR-era](https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars:_Knights_of_the_Old_Republic) Star Wars character [Uziel Astaroth](https://www.deviantart.com/stygianemperor/art/Uziel-Colorized-498803167)'s lightsaber, at least his main-hand one. I've never liked the original crossguard lightsaber concept with the weird little lipstick blades, so instead it has physical [cortosis-weave](https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Cortosis-weave) quillons to protect your hands. ![Lightsaber with smoky blade](https://i.imgur.com/6bJBeDm.png)

results.name: Victoria Noir, futuristic executive
results.description: Victoria Noir is a stylized high-detail adult female character embodying sleek, authoritarian sophistication and futuristic corporate power. She wears a glossy black leather tailored jacket and matching fitted trousers with polished black boots, complemented by platinum-blonde hair, oversized black sunglasses, and dark lipstick. Seated with composed confidence in a sculptural white executive chair, she is well suited for cyberpunk settings, corporate thrillers, cinematic scenes, games, virtual production, and immersive XR experiences.
